fix-handle-collective-multiple-host-on-d.reason: mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration dereferenced without optional chaining; throws when destinationCalendar is null/empty.
Fallback in updateEvent/deleteEvent searches for externalId equal to the absent externalCalendarId, so it never matches and the destination calendar is lost.
Hangout-link events.patch uses undefined calendarId when no destination matches the credentialId, so the Meet link is never added.
updateLocation reads externalId/credentialId from updateEvent results that never return them, so rewritten references lose calendar and credential.
Non-Google calendar services (Office365/Lark) ignore credentialId and always use the first destination calendar, so other hosts get events on the organizer calendar.
Recurring bulk deletion now runs inside the per-reference loop, repeating the full deletion once per reference with duplicate delete calls.
Video booking references lose credentialId due to the calendar-only ternary, so cancellation cannot find the video credential.

add-guest-management-functionality-to-ex.reason: isTeamAdminOrOwner uses && so only owners pass and team admins are denied.
Core fix is capping the unbounded guests array that any authorized attendee can submit, triggering mass inserts and emails.
Blacklist is lowercased but guest input is not, so case variants bypass BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS.
EventManager built from the caller credentials instead of the organizer, so non-organizer additions do not update the organizer calendar.
Calendar update runs after DB persist without try/catch, so a failure aborts the mutation after guests are saved.
sendAddGuestsEmails receives raw guests instead of uniqueGuests, so existing attendees get the new-booking email.

enhance-embed-url-handling-and-validatio.reason: raw_html cook method returns unsanitized imported HTML rendered with raw post.cooked, stored XSS.
embed stylesheet and embed.js are not in config.assets.precompile, so they fail in production.
i.content.scrub without nil guard raises NoMethodError for feed items lacking content and aborts the import.
postMessage origin check uses indexOf substring test instead of exact origin equality.

notification-rule-processing-engine-graf.reason: GrafanaRuleListItem in the Grafana branch of FilterView is rendered without a key prop.
In the prom-only list path the Silence item is shown but the silence drawer requires a ruler rule, so clicking does nothing.
useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined) reports Duplicate as supported, and AlertRuleMenu ORs it in, showing Duplicate on cloud rules.
useAllAlertRuleAbilities delegates to useAllRulerRuleAbilities with isFederated hardcoded false, so federated rules become editable/deletable.

add-html-sanitizer-for-translated-messag.reason: Lithuanian totpStep1/loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text.
Lithuanian login bundle loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text.
zh_CN totpStep1 uses Traditional instead of Simplified Chinese.

feature-automatically-downsize-large-ima.reason: downsize defined twice; new signature overrides the old and breaks 5-arg callers like ResizeEmoji.
Passing "80%" as dimensions makes gifsicle --resize-fit fail for animated GIFs, so downsizing silently fails (also notes ignored return value).
Client-side size check hardcodes 10MB instead of per-type max_<type>_size_kb, diverging from server limits for attachments.

fix-proper-handling-of-group-memberships.reason: add_members pushes existing members, hitting the unique group_users index with a 500 and partial adds.
Public members endpoint takes limit from params without upper/lower bound.
totalPages uses floor(user_count/limit)+1, giving an extra empty page on exact multiples.

anonymous-add-configurable-device-limit-.reason: tagDeviceUI caches the device before CreateOrUpdateDevice, so a rejected device bypasses the limit on later requests within the cache TTL.
Non-atomic count-then-insert lets concurrent new devices exceed the device limit.

feature-localization-fallbacks-server-si.reason: Translation cache key ignores default_locale/site, so fallback results go stale when the default locale changes.
Fallback catalogs only loaded in the controller set_locale filter, so jobs/mailers cannot fall back.

implement-access-token-context-encoding-.reason: Constructor checks grantType twice instead of rawTokenId, so null rawTokenId passes.
isAccessTokenId reads wrong substring offset and inverts the comparison, so grant type is never verified.

feat-workflow-engine-add-in-hook-for-pro.reason: MetricAlertDetectorHandler subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler without implementing abstract methods, raising TypeError on instantiation.

span-buffer-multiprocess-enhancement-wit.reason: isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process) is false for SpawnProcess, so hung flushers are never killed.
